q: summarize the employee handbook leave policy
answer: The leave policy requires employees to follow specific procedures for requesting leave. For leaves under 3 days, a one-week prior approval is needed in Matrix. For more than 3 days, an application must be submitted four weeks in advance. Sick leaves are limited to six per year and require medical certification if taken for over two days; they cannot be carried forward. Probationary employees have a maximum of three sick leave days. The policy also allows for other types of leave to maintain work-life balance. Sources: (Samta-Employee Handbook April_2026.pdf)
